message:
Added Intake to web frameworks based on HttpRouter (#356)

* include intake in README

* README: keep list of frameworks sorted

---------

Co-authored-by: Julien Schmidt <julienschmidt@users.noreply.github.com>

pr.title: Added Intake to web frameworks based on HttpRouter
pr.body: Intake is my project and love that it uses httprouter under the hood. Thanks @julienschmidt

diff:
diff --git a/README.md b/README.md
index bf54e26..48e96ec 100644
--- a/README.md
+++ b/README.md
@@ -291,6 +291,7 @@ If the HttpRouter is a bit too minimalistic for you, you might try one of the fo
 * [Hikaru](https://github.com/najeira/hikaru): Supports standalone and Google AppEngine
 * [Hitch](https://github.com/nbio/hitch): Hitch ties httprouter, [httpcontext](https://github.com/nbio/httpcontext), and middleware up in a bow
 * [httpway](https://github.com/corneldamian/httpway): Simple middleware extension with context for httprouter and a server with gracefully shutdown support
+* [intake](https://github.com/dbubel/intake): intake is a minimal http framework with enphasis on middleware groups
 * [Jett](https://github.com/saurabh0719/jett): A lightweight framework with subrouters, graceful shutdown and middleware at all levels.
 * [kami](https://github.com/guregu/kami): A tiny web framework using x/net/context
 * [Medeina](https://github.com/imdario/medeina): Inspired by Ruby's Roda and Cuba

explanation.what: README.md のサードパーティフレームワーク一覧に intake (github.com/dbubel/intake) を1行追加した。httpway と Jett の間、アルファベット順を保つ位置に挿入されている。
explanation.why: PR body で作者自身が、自分のプロジェクト intake が内部で httprouter を使っていることへの謝辞とともに一覧への追加を提案しており、コミットメッセージにも「README: keep list of frameworks sorted」という共著者(Julien Schmidt)によるソート順維持の指摘が含まれている。
